ideas.pitch: Multilingual AI-powered regional agricultural crop disease and subsidy intelligence platform optimized for Uttar Pradesh agrarian clusters.
ideas.title: KisanKavach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets Northern India's regional grassroots agricultural challenges, aligning with the core mission of Hack Uttar Pradesh 2026.

ideas.pitch: Real-time regional crop price forecasting and supply chain analytics engine for UP agricultural mandis using time-series modeling.
ideas.title: MandiPredict
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous data science execution and practical economic value for local farmers across districts.

ideas.pitch: Satellite-powered water quality and industrial effluent monitoring platform mapping pollution hotspots across UP industrial corridors.
ideas.title: GangaSentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies satellite data intelligence to a high-priority environmental and regional governance issue in Uttar Pradesh.

ideas.pitch: Open-source regional legal document simplifier translating Hindi and Awadhi land revenue records into clear consumer summaries.
ideas.title: BhashaLegal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent everyday bureaucratic problem for rural citizens in UP by bridging the language and literacy gap.

ideas.pitch: Zero-commission AR-enabled artisan marketplace and digital passport generator for GI-tagged crafts of Uttar Pradesh.
ideas.title: CraftConnect-UP
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge AR mobile onboarding with regional economic empowerment for local artisans and weavers.
